semantics: Only epoch/fingerprint-matched descriptors and already contiguous pages from the existing pool are eligible.
A miss neither performs I/O nor evicts frames; the ordinary compiler/paged path remains.
Fresh per-call continuation and I/O state, persistent language-specific numeric banks.
The ordinary APP flow and loader retain INPUT/resume, finish/error/editor and APP-eviction handling.
Raw LBV2 line lookup uses the pinned image throughout callbacks/INPUT; no native APP pointer is cached.
The original resident certificate check and CORRUPT_MODULE contract are retained before VM entry.

Only the prepared path may reuse transient prefix scratch without an extra full clear; live state is initialised, other owners retain zeroing and close still scrubs the complete prefix before publishing a snapshot.

performance.method: Ordinary M61/OPEN. Same game and byte-identical five APPs; only resident differs. MCU accepted OK -> next key wait for shipping timing; separate diagnostic profile/GAP/nonce-PONG.
notes: First two searches per stage excluded from warm comparison; each mode has two samples.
Within comparison.stages, saved_seconds/elapsed_reduction_percent measure USB Screen overhead. The optimisation gain is reported only in comparison.modes.
Headless means protocol detached, cable connected and physical LCD active; MCU timer freezes before reattachment after the fixed 45-second observation.
First-compilation rows are single observations, not statistical cold-start estimates; internal NOR journal layout is not cloned between stages.

qualification.actual_ARM: Both backends, real frontends and VM, >64-KiB paged and small raw/paged images, three APP addresses, INPUT eviction/resume.

rejected_attempt.reason: The initial DFU command was closed before the receiver consumed it. No candidate was installed. Full original Flash/files/state independently restored. Harness now retains CDC for the same 200-ms handoff as the existing flash helper; identity/descriptor/CRC/deadlines unchanged.

exploratory_variant.defect: Malformed descriptor reached the VM rather than retaining the original resident-side rejection. Negative real-C9 test caught it; fixed2 restores that check and additionally avoids redundant scratch initialisation. First timing cohort is excluded from final statistics.
